minutes.headline: Board put most town meeting warrant articles on the warrant; override and school supplement deferred to next night.
minutes.summary: After executive session, the board heard public comment on school funding, special education and an override, then a resident's cemetery warrant article and cemetery corporation proposal. It went through the annual town meeting warrant article by article, including most and deferring many recommendations, and approved an amended letter to the state delegation on local aid. It also approved a Lions Club car show license and toll booth application and reviewed the vacancy list.

public_comment.topic: Student urged that special education services not be cut and said he accepts sports cuts or fees.
Firefighters' union spokesman said the town needs a whole-town override and that three requested firefighter positions will not be funded without one.
Said the Lions Club cruise night has a rain date.
Asked how the citizen petition override could be withdrawn.

votes.motion: Enter executive session (litigation strategy), roll call
Approve special event license for Lions Club car show
Approve toll booth application, allow rain date within two weeks
Approve letter to state delegation as amended

decisions.decision: Articles approved subject to final language from town counsel; warrant to printer by April 7.

what_happened.line: The Select Board went through the annual town meeting warrant article by article, including most and deferring many recommendations, subject to final language from town counsel.
The override and school supplement articles were delayed to the next night's meeting.
The board voted unanimously to include and recommend article A.
The board voted unanimously to approve a letter to the state delegation on local aid, as amended.
The board approved the Lions Club car show license and toll booth application unanimously, with a rain date allowed within two weeks.

why_it_matters: The override and school supplement articles, which bear most directly on the tax bill and school funding, were not settled and will be decided at the next night's meeting.

Public comment tied the override to staffing: a firefighters' union spokesman said three requested firefighter positions will not be funded without a whole-town override, and a student urged that special education not be cut.
